title: Before Pattinson's Bond
note: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond, in Denis Villeneuve's Bond 26. Five films that show why he's ready for 007.

post.sub: Robert Pattinson is 007. Denis Villeneuve directs. Here's the case for him.
